    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Oracle 23.26.4 新函数 BAR_CHART：把数字画成条形图</span>
    

</a>
</h2>
    <small>
<span id="post-date" data-last-update-days="0" data-date-updated="2026-11-12 06:52">2026-11-12 06:51</span>&nbsp;
<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jyzhao">AlfredZhao</a>&nbsp;
阅读(<span id="post_view_count">0</span>)&nbsp;
评论(<span id="post_comment_count">0</span>)&nbsp;
&nbsp;
<a href="javascript:void(0)" onclick="AddToWz(23635728);return false;">收藏</a>&nbsp;
<a href="https://report.cnblogs.com?targetLink=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cnblogs.com%2Fjyzhao%2Fp%2F23635728&amp;targetId=23635728&amp;targetType=0" target="_blank">举报</a>
</small>
    <div class="entry">
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>笔者最近发现，Oracle 在 23.26.4 版本中引入了一个挺有意思的函数 <code>BAR_CHART</code>。它能把数值或布尔值直接渲染成由字符组成的条形，在 SQL 结果里就能看到直观的图形。</p>
<p>官方对它的描述是：可以用 <code>BAR_CHART</code> 把数值或布尔值显示为字符条，并能指定条形代表的区间、宽度以及绘制用的字符。</p>
<h2 id="01--基本语法">01 | 基本语法</h2>
<p>函数的可用参数如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">BAR_CHART(value, maximum, minimum, width, symbol)
</code></pre>
<p>其中 <code>value</code> 是要展示的值，<code>maximum</code> 和 <code>minimum</code> 定义条形所代表的区间，<code>width</code> 是条形的宽度，<code>symbol</code> 是绘制条形所用的字符。</p>
<h2 id="02--用薪资数据试一试">02 | 用薪资数据试一试</h2>
<p>先对员工表的 <code>sal</code> 做展示，把薪资除以 50 后交给函数，其余参数使用默认值（默认区间与宽度以所用版本官方文档为准）：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT ename, sal, BAR_CHART(sal/50) FROM emp;
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/635610/202611/635610-20261112065141862-437966254.png" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>它同样支持 emoji。下面用布尔判断配合 `` 标记高薪员工：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT ENAME, sal,
  BAR_CHART(sal &gt;= 3000, 1, 0, 1, '') AS high_salary
FROM emp;
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/635610/202611/635610-20261112065143892-1998039157.png" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="03--玩得更花一些">03 | 玩得更花一些</h2>
<p>把区间、宽度和字符组合起来，还能做出分段阈值条。下面的例子用三种颜色区分薪资区间：以 2000 和 3000 为分界，分别用 、、 三段条形拼接（边界值具体落在哪一段以实际渲染结果为准），再用 <code>||</code> 拼接起来：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT
  ename,
  job,
  sal,
  bar_chart(sal) AS default_bar,
  bar_chart(sal, 5000, 0, 10) AS "10_CHAR_BAR",
  bar_chart(sal, 2000, 0, 5, '')
  || bar_chart(sal, 3000, 2000, 5, '')
  || bar_chart(sal, 5000, 3000, 5, '') AS threshold_bar,
  bar_chart(sal, 5000, 0, 5, '') AS "wage"
FROM emp
ORDER BY sal;
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/635610/202611/635610-20261112065146405-323234804.png" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="04--没有-emp-表怎么办">04 | 没有 emp 表怎么办</h2>
<p>文中用 <code>emp</code> 表举例。如果手头没有这张表，可以在测试环境中用下面的 SQL 快速构建 scott 版本的 <code>emp</code> 表并插入测试数据（执行前请确认当前 schema 下不存在同名表，避免冲突）：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">CREATE TABLE emp (
    empno    NUMBER(4) PRIMARY KEY,
    ename    VARCHAR2(10),
    job      VARCHAR2(9),
    mgr      NUMBER(4),
    hiredate DATE,
    sal      NUMBER(7,2),
    comm     NUMBER(7,2),
    deptno   NUMBER(2)
);

INSERT INTO emp VALUES (7369,'SMITH','CLERK',7902,TO_DATE('1980-12-17','YYYY-MM-DD'),800,NULL,20);
INSERT INTO emp VALUES (7499,'ALLEN','SALESMAN',7698,TO_DATE('1981-02-20','YYYY-MM-DD'),1600,300,30);
INSERT INTO emp VALUES (7521,'WARD','SALESMAN',7698,TO_DATE('1981-02-22','YYYY-MM-DD'),1250,500,30);
INSERT INTO emp VALUES (7566,'JONES','MANAGER',7839,TO_DATE('1981-04-02','YYYY-MM-DD'),2975,NULL,20);
INSERT INTO emp VALUES (7654,'MARTIN','SALESMAN',7698,TO_DATE('1981-09-28','YYYY-MM-DD'),1250,1400,30);
INSERT INTO emp VALUES (7698,'BLAKE','MANAGER',7839,TO_DATE('1981-05-01','YYYY-MM-DD'),2850,NULL,30);
INSERT INTO emp VALUES (7782,'CLARK','MANAGER',7839,TO_DATE('1981-06-09','YYYY-MM-DD'),2450,NULL,10);
INSERT INTO emp VALUES (7788,'SCOTT','ANALYST',7566,TO_DATE('1987-04-19','YYYY-MM-DD'),3000,NULL,20);
INSERT INTO emp VALUES (7839,'KING','PRESIDENT',NULL,TO_DATE('1981-11-17','YYYY-MM-DD'),5000,NULL,10);
INSERT INTO emp VALUES (7844,'TURNER','SALESMAN',7698,TO_DATE('1981-09-08','YYYY-MM-DD'),1500,0,30);
INSERT INTO emp VALUES (7876,'ADAMS','CLERK',7788,TO_DATE('1987-05-23','YYYY-MM-DD'),1100,NULL,20);
INSERT INTO emp VALUES (7900,'JAMES','CLERK',7698,TO_DATE('1981-12-03','YYYY-MM-DD'),950,NULL,30);
INSERT INTO emp VALUES (7902,'FORD','ANALYST',7566,TO_DATE('1981-12-03','YYYY-MM-DD'),3000,NULL,20);
INSERT INTO emp VALUES (7934,'MILLER','CLERK',7782,TO_DATE('1982-01-23','YYYY-MM-DD'),1300,NULL,10);

COMMIT;
</code></pre>
<p>这个函数用起来挺有意思，感兴趣的可以自己动手试试看。</p>
